package rulefixtures

// scenario for mutable_package_global: Package-level variables that are mutated from function bodies instead of kept immutable.
// fixture polarity: positive; family: idioms; severity: info.

var AppConfig = &Configuration{Port: 8080, Debug: false, MaxRetries: 3}

type Configuration struct {
	Port       int
	Debug      bool
	MaxRetries int
}

func EnableDebug() {
	AppConfig.Debug = true
}

func SetPort(port int) {
	AppConfig.Port = port
}

func UpdateRetries(n int) {
	AppConfig.MaxRetries = n
}
